item.name: Kitchen Waste Station
item.location: Kitchen, containers labeled Kitchen Waste Station.
item.readyBeforeUse: Each container is labeled, lined where required, and below its marked full line.
item.readyForNextPerson: Waste is inside the correct labeled containers. Lids are closed. No loose waste or MOOP is present around the station.
item.ifNotReady: Do not overflow a container or mix waste categories. Tell the Dominatrix.

problem.condition: A container reaches its marked full line.
problem.response: Do not add more waste. Tell the Dominatrix.

problem.condition: A container is missing a label or required liner.
problem.response: Do not use that container. Tell the Dominatrix.
